title: Inner Breeze: a day with Lumi
style: Premium hand-painted storybook 3D animated film, soft watercolor and gouache texture, warm golden light, gentle volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, calm graceful camera moves. Same look as Lumi and the painted Sun Salutation and Tai Chi characters. No text, no logos, no UI on screen.

cast.lumi: Lumi, a small round olive-green firefly with a cream golden glowing tummy, two curved antennae ending in golden lights, huge warm brown eyes, tiny translucent wings. The guide and narrator.
cast.mia: The Inner Breeze heroine from the Sun Salutation practice: a young woman with a light-brown ponytail, sage-teal fitted top and olive leggings, calm and kind.
cast.monk: Tibetan monk Tai Chi teacher: shaved head, saffron-yellow sleeveless wrap vest, maroon sash, deep red loose trousers, black cloth shoes.
cast.teacher: Tibetan woman Tai Chi teacher: dark braids wound round her head, white long-sleeved shirt, teal wrap vest, rainbow pangden-striped sash, navy loose trousers, red shoes.

clips.name: Firefly at dawn
clips.action: Blue hour at a misty forest lake. A tiny golden light blinks on among the reeds. Lumi rises into frame, brightens, turns to camera, smiles, waves and says hello.

clips.name: Sunrise welcome
clips.action: First sunrise light in a cozy wooden cabin bedroom. Lumi flutters in through the open window; Mia wakes, stretches and smiles at Lumi. Right third of the frame calm and soft.

clips.name: Breath on the dock
clips.action: Mia sits cross-legged on a wooden dock over the misty lake at sunrise, eyes closed, taking one slow deep breath; her breath shows in the cool air. Lumi hovers beside her, its glow swelling and softening with her breath. Right third calm.

clips.name: Stillness, then the Sun Salutation
clips.action: One continuous take on a sunlit mountain ledge above a sea of golden clouds. Mia meditates, hands in her lap; a small brass bell beside her rings and sends one soft ripple of light while Lumi floats still. Then she rises gracefully and flows into the Sun Salutation: arms sweep up into upward salute as Lumi traces a golden arc along her hands. Keep the right third calm in the second half.

clips.name: Tai Chi in the monastery
clips.action: Misty Himalayan monastery courtyard at sunrise, prayer flags, stone steps, white stupas. The monk performs Tai Chi Wave Hands Like Clouds with slow flowing arms; Mia beside him follows the same movement in mirror.

clips.name: Brush knee and push
clips.action: Same courtyard, wider, sun rays through the mist. Dolma and the monk perform Brush Knee and Push in perfect unison, stepping forward and slowly pushing one palm. Lumi draws a thin glowing golden ribbon along the path of their hands.

clips.name: Habits and the evening diary
clips.action: One continuous take at Mia's cozy wooden desk by a rain-streaked window in warm lamp light. A glass of water and a bowl of fruit on the desk; above the desk a row of seven small floating circles of light fills with gold one after another as Lumi touches them. Then Mia opens her paper journal and writes with a soft smile while Lumi settles on the lamp shade. Right third calm.

clips.name: Just ask
clips.action: Night. Mia curled up on a sofa under a knitted blanket, holding her phone (screen angled away). Lumi flies up out of the phone's soft glow, says 'just ask', and they share a warm smile. Right third calm.

clips.name: A breeze of light
clips.action: Starry night above the calm lake. Lumi flies upward, leaving a long golden trail that curls like a gentle breeze across the sky; the camera rises slowly. Upper center of the frame open and dark for the title.
